ValidationRule.description: External LOs (custom permission External_LO) may move a lead to Pre-Approval with no loan amount (decided 2026-10-20).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Pre-Approval'), ISBLANK(Loan_Amount__c), NOT($Permission.External_LO), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Status), ISCHANGED(Loan_Amount__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Loan Amount field must be filled in before applying for pre-approval
